name: AI & Technology Consulting
tagline: AI training, market research, and business documentation — the strategy and groundwork before, or alongside, any build.

hero.headline: Make Confident Decisions Before You Build
hero.subhead: Hands-on AI training, market research, and business documentation to give your team direction and your operations structure.

description: Not every engagement starts with a build. Sometimes what you need first is clarity — practical AI training for your team, real market and competitor research, or professional documentation that formalizes how your business runs. I combine AI-powered research and drafting with hands-on, practical delivery so you walk away with something you can actually use immediately.
problems: Your team knows AI is important but doesn't know where to start using it
You're making a business decision without real market or competitor data
Your business runs on tribal knowledge instead of documented processes
You're preparing for investment, hiring, or scaling and need to look like a serious operation
deliverables: Half-day hands-on AI training session with a custom plan for your industry and role
AI Prompt Library (30+ tested prompts) and an AI Tools reference guide
Market research report with competitor analysis, audience profile, and SWOT
Up to 3 professional business documents (SOPs, handbooks, agreements, business plans)
Recording of every training session plus a follow-up Q&A
Delivered in Word (.docx) and PDF formats
Certificate of completion for training participants
features: AI training tailored to your team's actual daily tasks, not generic theory
Competitor and market research delivered as a clean, actionable report
SOPs, employee handbooks, service agreements, and business plans
Technology roadmaps and AI adoption planning for the next stage of growth
Available online (Zoom/Meet) or in-person in Metro Manila and select areas

process.detail: A short call or written brief to understand your goals — training, research, or documentation.
A plan built around your industry, team, and specific business challenges.
Live training session, research report, or document drafts — with AI-assisted drafting and human refinement.
One round of revisions or a follow-up Q&A to make sure it's actually usable.
Final files delivered in editable and print-ready formats, plus recordings where applicable.

faqs.question: Do participants need prior AI experience for training?
faqs.answer: No. Training starts from the basics and progresses to practical business applications within the same session.

faqs.question: How accurate is AI-powered market research?
faqs.answer: Highly effective for publicly available information — market trends, competitor positioning, and consumer behavior. Key data points are verified and clearly marked as estimated vs. confirmed.

faqs.question: Are the business documents legally binding?
faqs.answer: They follow standard professional formats, but for legally sensitive agreements I recommend having a licensed attorney review before use.

faqs.question: Can training be done online?
faqs.answer: Yes — via Zoom or Google Meet. In-person is available in Metro Manila and selected areas in the Philippines.
